compliance.settlement_party: FSHC and Landmark AR Park Ridge, LLC

notes: Fourth Round prospective obligation = 124 units (Program recommendation Apr 17, 2025; DCA had 138; borough resolution committed to 119 based on Land Capacity Factor correction). Court order not yet issued as of HEFSP date. Present Need (rehabilitation) = 45 after Structural Conditions Survey (DCA had 137). Fourth Round RDP = 3 units from 2 sites (changed circumstances only: 1 unit from Landmark/Sony redevelopment + 2 units from 155 Park Avenue approved inclusionary addition). Unmet Need = 121 (4th round) + 79 (3rd round) = 200 combined. Third Round obligation = 225 (settled 2020); Third Round RDP = 146. Bear's Nest 100%-affordable project (50 units) was found completely undevelopable due to wetlands/steep slopes in Dec 2021 and removed from plan. Candidate snapshot had rdp=3, prospective=119 — RDP count correct but prospective should be 124 per Program recommendation.

sources.title: 2025 Housing Element and Fair Share Plan, Borough of Park Ridge
sources.excerpt: Table 1: Affordable Housing Obligations Summary ... Fourth Round Obligation (2025-2035): 124 ... Present Need (Rehabilitation) Obligation: 45

sites.address: 1 Sony Drive (Brae Boulevard and Sony Drive)
sites.quote: The approximately 30-acre property is identified by municipal tax records as Block 301 Lot 1 and was previously developed with the former Sony Electronics, Inc. corporate headquarters.
sites.notes: 448 total units (371 MF rental + 77 townhouse rental), 68 affordable family rental units at min 15% set-aside. Board resolution memorialized Jan 11, 2023. Borough assigns 67 units to 3rd Round RDP and 1 unit to 4th Round RDP. Also 22 bonus credits to 3rd Round RDP. Under construction.

sites.quote: The 155 Park Avenue site is a through-lot with frontage on Park, Highview and Chestnut Avenues. It is identified by Borough tax records as Block 1807 Lot 5 and encompasses an area of approximately 3.21 acres.
sites.notes: 16 new units added to existing Park Terrace Apartments complex; 2 affordable family rental units; approval granted July 12, 2023 by Planning Board; 1-year extension to July 2026 granted. Site within 1/4 mile of Park Ridge Train Station (eligible for transit bonus, not applied). Contributes 2 units to 4th Round RDP. Changed circumstance site — site plan approval post-2018 VLA.

sites.quote: affordable housing zones for a 4.43-acre area along Hawthorne Avenue (comprised of Block 1401 Lots 4, 5 and 6 and Block 1403 Lot 1) and a 2.04-acre area on Wampum Road (comprised of Block 1602 Lot 5). This zoning ... permits townhouses, garden apartments, and multifamily residential up to a density of 12 units per acre with a required 20 percent set-aside
sites.notes: Unmet Need mechanism; permits up to 12 du/ac, 20% set-aside; anticipated 11-12 additional affordable units above Quail Run (already credited). Block 1401 Lot 5 already developed as Quail Run (4 units counted toward 1st/2nd round). 4.43 ac Hawthorne + 2.04 ac Wampum = 6.47 ac total.

sites.address: Park Avenue and Broadway corridor (vicinity of train station)
sites.quote: the Borough will continue to maintain the NB Zone – which permits mixed-use development with residential uses above the ground floor with a required 20 percent set-aside for affordable units ... It is anticipated that the NB Zone could yield approximately 80-95 additional affordable units
sites.notes: 44-acre Neighborhood Business zone along Park Ave/Broadway near train station; 20% set-aside for mixed-use; anticipated 80-95 additional affordable units (4th Round Unmet Need only). No block/lot specified in HEFSP for this zone-wide mechanism. Established 2010, expanded 2011.
